0.content: Two volumes of verse handed down from the Aristocratic period, said to come from Ragnvindr himself. Vol. 1 is a squire's night patrol through a city of luxury and misery, where the poor weep, the knights boast of starlight and the wind carries the grief of the oppressed against the palace walls. Vol. 2 tells of a chained dancer from the Wanderer's Troupe whose silence was a song of freedom, who told her lonely listeners tales of the nobles' divine-powered ancestors, angels, gods and dragons, and whose final sword performance in the arena was cut short.

1.comment: Ragnvindr: The Dawnlight Swordswoman and The Flute
1.content: A sword-dancer of the Wanderer's Troupe, who fought the Aristocracy and, after the uprising failed, was enslaved as a gladiator. Her sword, The Flute, sang when swung with skill. Ragnvindr saw her final match, buried her with the sword and took the name Dawn Knight in her honour.

2.content: According to the Favonius Codex text, when the Knights of Favonius was founded, Ragnvindr turned the aristocrats' indoor baths into a library. Gifts from bards, scholars and travellers made it the largest collection in the northern half of the continent. It later burned in the Great Fire of Fall Equinox, so only part of the collection survives; a poplar door in the basement is said to predate the library, and the Knights say the restricted section lies behind it.

3.content: A weapon text that came as a reward from the limited Invitation of Windblume event (2021). It tells how the Windblume flower became a secret sign among those resisting Decarabian, mentions the Red-Haired Warrior, and then names Ragnvindr as another red-haired knight of the Aristocratic age whose clan "shall ever live in the darkness and bring forth the flame of dawn."

4.comment: Ragnvindr: Ragnvindr Clan and Dawn Winery
4.content: An influential Mondstadt family named after the Dawn Knight, and one of two known noble families not exiled after the aristocracy fell (with the Gunnhildr Clan). They run the Dawn Winery, Mondstadt's premier winery. Crepus and Diluc are descendants; Kaeya was adopted into the family.
